brief.claim: The task engages region A more than region B: the task-evoked signal change (task minus rest) is larger in region A than in region B, with the mean across subjects of the within-subject difference of the two signal changes positive, and a paired t test of that difference gives two-sided p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: mean signal in region A of each subject during task blocks (percent signal change units)
mean signal in region A of each subject during rest blocks
mean signal in region B of each subject during task blocks
mean signal in region B of each subject during rest blocks

brief.sizes: subjects = 24 (each of the four keys: 24 values)
